title.narrative: English Training Course for Women Scientists

description.narrative: Nowadays possessing English proficiency is one of the prerequisites for scientists to acquire knowledge of science and technology and for taking part in international academic exchanges. In language acquisition, female scientists have less opportunity and time relative to their peer males due to some unavoidable circumstances including pregnancy, childbirth, childcare and family caring affairs. This project aims to organize an English language training courses for young women scientists by inviting a foreign professional lecturer to improve their English language abilities to actively participate in academic exchange activities such as writing research papers and presenting their results at international conferences.
